title: Frontend: Update syllabus topic schedule display — remove venue, add instructor, relabel + durationUnit badge
content:
Completed changes to CourseDetailView.tsx:
1. Removed venue/MapPin icon from each schedule line in syllabus section
2. Added instructor row (User icon + labels.instructor + name + title qualifications)
3. Changed from single "scheduleAndLocation" sub-header to two rows per schedule entry:
   - Row 1: Calendar icon + labels.dateAndTime + dateAndTime
   - Row 2: User icon + labels.instructor + instructor name + (title)
4. Syllabus duration badge now renders as {mod.duration} {dict.labels?.durationUnit}
   (e.g. "Duration: 1.5 hours" / "單元時數: 1.5 小時")
5. Removed unused Award/MapPin imports from lucide-react
acceptance: Each schedule displays dateAndTime with Calendar icon + labels.dateAndTime as first row
Each schedule displays instructor name + title with User icon + labels.instructor as second row
No venue/MapPin display in syllabus schedule section
Duration badge shows numeric value + durationUnit from dict
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: 1) npm run typecheck && npm run lint 2) Browse /en/courses/CPD26090103 — syllabus schedules show date+instructor without venue, duration shows localized unit
